summary.text: Tavis Hasenfus is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 57 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney from Readfield, Maine, he has served on the House Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tavis Hasenfus was born in Augusta, Maine, and lives in Readfield, Maine.
He graduated from Winthrop High School and earned a B.A. in philosophy in 2010 and a J.D. in 2013, both from the University of Maine.

His career experience includes working as an attorney, and he has served on the board of directors of the Friends of the Cobbosee Watershed and been affiliated with the Winthrop Area Chamber of Commerce.
Ballotpedia lists Hasenfus's tenure in the Maine House as beginning in 2020, with the current District 57 seat assumed on December 6, 2022.

He was assigned to the Ethics Committee in 2025-2026, to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee and the Taxation Committee in 2023-2024, and to the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee in 2021-2022.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
